description: This file contains Cypress test scripts for testing the Item Dashboard in an ERPNext application. It includes setup steps, test cases for verifying dashboard display, data persistence, and reload behavior.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup hook that logs in, navigates to the item page, inserts a test item, and navigates to that item document.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for dashboard display, persistence on field change, and persistence after reload.
